Vitassium Extra strength capsules
Provides extra sodium and potassium

Get the sodium you need, in fewer capsules. These extra strength capsules contain 50% more sodium per capsule than the original vitassium capsules.
Suggested use: Take 1-2 capsules with water.
As a medical food, your healthcare provider can advise how vitassium extra strength capsules fit into daily routine.
Caution: Consult a healthcare provider before using this product, especially if you are pregnant or nursing, a child under 18, or an individual with a contraindicated medical condition.
